title: Tech Note: Addendum - GDIPlus Plug-in Version 1.1

historical_commentary.text: This addendum documents version 1.1 improvements to the GDIPlus plug-in, including adoption of the new 4D 2004 Plug-In Architecture, a Mac OS X stub, scrollbar/mouse-wheel support, and a new Get Picture as blob command. The GDIPlus plug-in itself is a discontinued third-party/legacy plug-in tied to the pre-Unicode, pre-Universal Binary 4D 2003/2004 plug-in API, so this specific plug-in and its API generation are now obsolete, though 4D still supports compiled plug-ins built on later, Unicode-aware API generations. Only the teaser/bullet-point summary could be recovered for this note.
related_updates: The GDIPlus plug-in and its 2004-era plug-in API generation have long been superseded by later 4D Plug-in API versions (Unicode-aware, Universal Binary, and beyond)
